spec.description:
Gain insight into the energy usage and costs as well as the carbon emissions of your data center (a site) and its monitored hosts with MetricsHub. Optimize the ambient temperature of your data center based on data-driven recommendations and reduce your cooling costs.

MetricsHubs collects metrics from servers (Cisco, Dell, HPE, Huawei, IBM Lenovo, SuperMicro, etc.), storage systems (NetApp, Dell EMC, Hitachi, HPE, IBM, Pure, Huawei, etc.), network devices (Cisco, Aruba, Dell, HP, F5, Juniper, Oracle) and other equipment like PDUs, UPS from APC, Raritan, Eaton, etc.

spec.title: Collect Started
spec.description: Time since the collect of data by Hardware Sentry was first started for the site.

spec.title: Margin of Error
spec.description:
The percentage of possible deviation from an exact power consumption value.

This value is based on the collected data of monitored hosts reporting power consumption and estimated values for hosts not reporting their power consumption.

When the power consumed by a host cannot be read, Hardware Sentry estimates this value based on the typical consumption of a host's components (CPUs, disks, network interfaces, etc.).

spec.expr: (sum(hw_host_power_watts{quality="estimated", site="$site"} * 15) + sum(hw_host_power_watts{quality="measured", site="$site"} * 5) + 10000 * (sum(present_over_time(metricshub_host_configured{site="$site"}[1h])) - (count(max by (host_name) (metricshub_connector_status{state="ok", site="$site"} == 1))))) / (sum(hw_host_power_watts{site="$site"}) + 100 * (sum(present_over_time(metricshub_host_configured{site="$site"}[1h])) - (count(max by (host_name) (metricshub_connector_status{state="ok", site="$site"} == 1)))))

spec.title: Coverage
spec.description:
The percentage of monitored hosts.

A monitored host is a host with at least one responding connector.

spec.expr: count(max by (host_name, site) (metricshub_connector_status{state="ok", site=~"$site"} == 1)) / sum(max by (host_name, site) (present_over_time(metricshub_host_configured{site=~"$site"}[1h])))

spec.title: PUE
spec.description: The average of the Power Usage Effectiveness over 2 hours.

spec.title: Total Power * PUE
spec.description:
The site's current power usage multiplied by the site's PUE, displayed as a graph.

This number represents the actual power usage of a data center. It takes into account the cooling and other overhead that supports the equipment.

spec.title: PUE (24 hrs)
spec.description: The average of the Power Usage Effectiveness over 24 hours.

spec.title: Yearly Cost
spec.description:
The overall energy cost reported for the site in the past year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.title: Yearly CO₂ Emissions
spec.description:
The overall volume of CO₂ emitted by the site during the past year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.title: Monthly Cost
spec.description:
The overall energy cost reported for the site during the last 30 days.

If less than 30 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.title: Monthly CO₂ Emissions
spec.description:
The overall volume of CO₂ emitted by the site during the last 30 days.

If less than 30 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.title: Daily Cost
spec.description:
The overall energy cost reported for the site during the last 24 hours.

If less than 24 hours of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.title: Daily CO₂ Emissions
spec.description:
The overall volume of CO₂ emitted by the site during the last 24 hours.

If less than 24 hours of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.title: Yearly Consumption
spec.description:
The overall power consumption reported for the site during the last year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.title: Daily Consumption
spec.description:
The overall power consumption reported for the site in the last 24 hours.

If less than 24 hours of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.title: Monthly Consumption
spec.description:
The overall power consumption reported for the site during the last 30 days.

If less than 30 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.title: Daily Energy Consumption (last 30 days)
spec.description: The site's daily energy consumption for the past 30 days, as reported.

spec.title: Heating Margin Host Distribution
spec.description:
The number of hosts according to their heating margin.

The abscissa shows the heating margin.
The ordinate represents the number of hosts  for a given heating margin.

spec.title: Total Power
spec.description: The total current power consumption of all the hosts in the site.

spec.title: Heating Margin
spec.description:
The number of degrees Celsius (°C) remaining before the temperature of a host in the site reaches its closest warning temperature threshold.

It is advised to keep the heating margin above 5°C.

spec.title: Hosts
spec.description: The number of hosts currently configured to be monitored.

spec.title: Total Power * PUE
spec.description:
The site's current power usage multiplied by the site's PUE.

This number represents the site's actual power usage. It takes into account the cooling and other overhead that supports the equipment.

spec.title: Current Site Temperature
spec.description: The estimation of the site's temperature based on the ambient temperature of all hosts in the site.

spec.title: Today's Live CO₂ Emissions
spec.description: Today's volume of CO₂ emissions for the site.

spec.title: Electricity Cost
spec.description: Electricity cost, as provided in the configuration file.

spec.title: CO₂ Intensity
spec.description: The CO₂ electricity emissions, as provided in the configuration file.

spec.title: Host Types
spec.description: The total number of hosts per type: compute (server), storage and network.

spec.expr:
(
  count(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="critical", site=~"$site", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Hardware-.*"}) by (host_name)
  or 
  (0 * count by (host_name) (hw_host_power_watts{site=~"$site"})) # This is used to make sure a column is always created
)

(
  count(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{severity="warning", site=~"$site", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Hardware-.*"}) by (host_name)
  or 
  (0 * count by (host_name) (hw_host_power_watts{site=~"$site"})) # This is used to make sure a column is always created
)

sum by (host_name) (metricshub_connector_status{site=~"$site", state="failed"}) 
or 
(0 * count by (host_name) (hw_host_power_watts{site=~"$site"}))

spec.title: CPUs
spec.description: The total number of CPUs currently monitored.

spec.title: Disk Space
spec.description: The total disk space in the site.

spec.title: Connected NICs
spec.description: The total number of connected network cards.

spec.title: Network Tx
spec.description: The total volume of network transfers in the site.

spec.title: Monitoring Confidence
spec.description: The percentage of hosts for which temperature readings are reported.

spec.title: Site Heating Margin
spec.description: The lowest host's heating margin of all hosts in the site.

spec.title: Recommended Max Site Temperature
spec.description: The recommended site temperature based on the site's current heating margin, as well as the current and past site temperatures.

spec.title: Potential Yearly Energy Savings
spec.description:
The estimated energy consumption cuts based on the current power consumption, heating margin, site temperature and recommended site temperature.

If the recommended site temperature is lower than the current site temperature, this number may be negative.

spec.title: Potential Yearly Savings
spec.description:
The estimated yearly savings based on the current power consumption, heating margin, site temperature and recommended site temperature.

If the recommended site temperature is lower than the current site temperature, this number may be negative.

spec.title: Potential Yearly CO₂ Reduction
spec.description:
The estimated CO₂ emissions reduction based on the current power consumption, heating margin, site temperature and recommended site temperature.

If the recommended site temperature is lower than the current site temperature, this number may be negative.

spec.title: Hosts Vendors
spec.description: The hosts distribution per manufacturer.

spec.title: Today's Live Consumption
spec.description: Today's power consumption for the site.

spec.title: Today's Live Cost
spec.description: Today's power cost for the site.

spec.title: Hardware Site (MetricsHub)
